usedFor: Shopify raises order events, and Heap Analytics receives them through “Track Event” and “Add User to Heap”.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Track Event” in Heap Analytics
bestTemplate.why: A paid order is a clear conversion, and the action sends it to Heap as an event.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” in Shopify fires on edits, so “Track Event” can record the same order twice.
